summary: The Metals Royalty Company Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a $140.035 million private placement of 8.00% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2031, issued at 95% of par to institutional and accredited investors on August 24, 2026. Scotiabank and William Blair acted as placement agents. The notes convert at $8.66 per common share, a 37.5% premium over the $6.30 reference price. Interest is a mix of cash and PIK, with mandatory redemption at 112.5% after September 2029. The proceeds are used for general corporate purposes, not a return of capital to shareholders; the company is raising debt capital, so this is classified as a capital-raising event rather than a special-situation return. What to watch: the conversion premium and second-lien structure may signal future dilution or strategic initiatives.
